propositions: The outbound differ compares fields in vendor shape while the inbound differ compares in canonical shape, creating an asymmetry that violates the adapter seam principle

The outbound update path must canonicalize the snapshot via InboundMapper before comparison and emit vendor payloads only via OutboundMapper at the boundary, eliminating vendor-shaped field references from core
The InboundMapper output must include three new canonical keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) to enable neutral field-comparison helpers that do not reference vendor keys
The outbound differ must support partial-input map_remote_to_local (for stored baseline subsets) by emitting only canonical keys whose vendor source key is present, never defaulting absent keys

The assignee resolver must be re-homed to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee, parameterized only on canonical assignee_identity shape, preserving the accountId fast-path and unmappable→unassign soft-fail semantics
The outbound differ must contain no adapters.jira imports and no vendor snapshot key literals, verified by AST and denylist gates
